MATCH (a:Issue)-[r]->(b:Issue) WHERE type(r)<>'HAS_PARENT' RETURN type(r) AS t, count(*) AS c

MATCH p=(a:Issue)-[:BLOCKER|BONFIRE_TESTING|CAUSE|CLONERS|DEPENDS|DERIVED|DETAIL|DUPLICATE|FOLLOWS|PART|REFERENCE|REGRESSION|RELATE|RELATED|RESOLVE|SPLIT|SUPERSESSION*1..5]->(b:Issue) WHERE all(n IN nodes(p)[0..] WHERE single(m IN nodes(p) WHERE m=n)) AND all(i IN range(0,length(p)-1) WHERE EXISTS{(nodes(p)[i])-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(x) WHERE NOT EXISTS{(nodes(p)[i+1])-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(x)} AND EXISTS{(nodes(p)[i+1])-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->()}}) RETURN length(p) AS l, count(*) AS c

MATCH p=(a:Issue)-[:BLOCKER|BONFIRE_TESTING|CAUSE|CLONERS|DEPENDS|DERIVED|DETAIL|DUPLICATE|FOLLOWS|PART|REFERENCE|REGRESSION|RELATE|RELATED|RESOLVE|SPLIT|SUPERSESSION*1..5]->(b:Issue) WHERE size(apoc.coll.toSet(nodes(p)))=length(p)+1 WITH p, [n IN nodes(p)| head([(n)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(x)|x.personKey])] AS asg WHERE none(x IN asg WHERE x IS NULL) AND all(i IN range(0,size(asg)-2) WHERE asg[i]<>asg[i+1]) RETURN length(p) AS l, count(*) AS c

MATCH p=(a:Issue)-[:BLOCKER|BONFIRE_TESTING|CAUSE|CLONERS|DEPENDS|DERIVED|DETAIL|DUPLICATE|FOLLOWS|PART|REFERENCE|REGRESSION|RELATE|RELATED|RESOLVE|SPLIT|SUPERSESSION*1..5]->(b:Issue) WITH p, nodes(p) AS ns WHERE all(i IN range(0,size(ns)-1) WHERE all(j IN range(i+1,size(ns)-1) WHERE ns[i]<>ns[j])) WITH p, [n IN ns| head([(n)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(x)|x.personKey])] AS asg WHERE none(x IN asg WHERE x IS NULL) AND all(i IN range(0,size(asg)-2) WHERE asg[i]<>asg[i+1]) RETURN length(p) AS l, count(*) AS c

MATCH p=(a:Issue)-[:BLOCKER|BONFIRE_TESTING|CAUSE|CLONERS|DEPENDS|DERIVED|DETAIL|DUPLICATE|FOLLOWS|PART|REFERENCE|REGRESSION|RELATE|RELATED|RESOLVE|SPLIT|SUPERSESSION*1..5]->(b:Issue) WITH p, nodes(p) AS ns WHERE all(i IN range(0,size(ns)-1) WHERE all(j IN range(i+1,size(ns)-1) WHERE ns[i]<>ns[j])) WITH p, ns, [n IN ns| head([(n)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(x)|x.personKey])] AS asg WHERE none(x IN asg WHERE x IS NULL) AND all(i IN range(0,size(asg)-2) WHERE asg[i]<>asg[i+1]) RETURN [n IN ns|n.issueKey] AS path, asg AS people, [n IN ns| head([(n)-[:IN_PROJECT]->(q)|q.projectKey])] AS projects, [r IN relationships(p)|r.linkId] AS links, [r IN relationships(p)|type(r)] AS types

MATCH p=(a:Issue)-[:BLOCKER|BONFIRE_TESTING|CAUSE|CLONERS|DEPENDS|DERIVED|DETAIL|DUPLICATE|FOLLOWS|PART|REFERENCE|REGRESSION|RELATE|RELATED|RESOLVE|SPLIT|SUPERSESSION*1..5]->(b:Issue) WITH p, nodes(p) AS ns WHERE all(i IN range(0,size(ns)-1) WHERE all(j IN range(i+1,size(ns)-1) WHERE ns[i]<>ns[j])) WITH p, ns, [n IN ns| head([(n)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(x)|x.personKey])] AS asg WHERE none(x IN asg WHERE x IS NULL) AND all(i IN range(0,size(asg)-2) WHERE asg[i]<>asg[i+1]) WITH p, ns, asg, [n IN ns| head([(n)-[:IN_PROJECT]->(q)|q.projectKey])] AS pr RETURN [n IN ns|n.issueKey] AS path, [i IN range(0,size(ns)-2)|[ns[i].issueKey,ns[i+1].issueKey]] AS issues, [i IN range(0,size(ns)-2)|[asg[i],asg[i+1]]] AS people, [i IN range(0,size(ns)-2)|[pr[i],pr[i+1]]] AS projects, [r IN relationships(p)|r.linkId] AS links, 'issue' AS kind
